title: US supreme court to decide on legality of Trump birthright citizenship order
summary: Justices to take up case amid legal fight over order to heavily restrict right to birthright citizenship in US The US supreme court agreed on Friday to decide the legality of Donald Trump’s order to heavily restrict the right to birthright citizenship in the United States. Trump’s executive order banning the constitutional right to US citizenship for almost everyone born on American soil was signed just hours after the US president took office for his second term – and was immediately challenged in court.
